page.title: General
page.about: Language, the look, and what Yuzora does when it opens.

language.heading: Language
language.title: Language
language.about: Shown now: {current}. System follows your computer's language; any Chinese shows Traditional Chinese.

look.heading: Look
look.about: For the layout you're in: each layout keeps its own light and dark theme.
look.appearance_about: Light or dark, or as your system is now.
look.layout_font: This layout sets its own; yours shows in the others.

startup.heading: When Yuzora opens
startup.sidebar_about: The sidebar mode to show first.

panels.heading: Panels
panels.about: Herdr's Files and Changes panels open beside your terminals from buttons in the tab bar. Yuzora's sidebar has its own Files and Git modes, so both start off.

security.heading: Terminal clipboard
security.clipboard_about: Programs in your terminals (remote ones too) can put text on the clipboard with OSC 52. Off: only what you copy yourself gets there. Reading the clipboard is never allowed.
